description: Native 68k port of the Fallout 2 Community Edition engine by DJBase (amigaworld.de) - RTG via cybergraphics, AHI audio with lipsync, MVE movies, optional Apollo AMMX acceleration. Ships the engine, a ReAction settings tool and dat2-extract; you supply the original Fallout 2 game data.
name: Fallout 2 CE (68k)
notes: Early debug build (author: not fully optimised yet). Requires original Fallout 2 data files, an RTG board with cybergraphics.library v40+, FPU, and 16-32 MB fast RAM.
